procedural_matters: The technical committee was represented by Melissa Goldstraß (member of the technical committee).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 191131, the boat being supported by Mr. Bastian Henning, was represented by Philipp Buhl.
Charlotte May (member of the technical committee) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: Following race 3 of the ILCA 7 fleet, Mr. Bastian Henning (support person 182) was not wearing a personal flotation device while waiting afloat between the finishing line and the starting area.
At the time of the incident Mr. Bastian Henning was not briefly changingor adjusting clothing or personal equipment.
At the time of the incident the personal flotation device was stored ina box at the back of his vessel.
During the hearing Mr. Bastian Henning admitted that he was not wearinga personal flotation device and apologized.
conclusions: By not wearing a personal flotation device while being afloat and notbriefly changing or adjusting clothing or personal equipment, Mr. BastianHenning broke ESTR 3.1.
Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats andSupport Persons a starting penalty of level 2 was decided.
Although the breach could have affected safety, the support person wasapologetic and promptly remedied the breach; the level 2 will hence stand.
decision: Mr. Bastian Henning shall stay ashore until the first race of his supported boat(s) on June 23rd has started.
